name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

targetCollection.description: Name of TargetCollection for this Transform. If not present, will use {@link TargetCollection#dfltFromTarget}

condition.description: Optional condition for filtering rows of instances of source type. #condition is applied first.

projection.description:
Json representing transform projection. I.e. instructions how to map Source to Target. Value expected to have keys
matching field names in Target type and values to be valid C3 expressions in the context of Source type. If for a
given key value is another Json Object then corresponding Target type field's value type needs to be a reference
and target for this nested projection becomes referenced C3 Type.

transformer.description:
If set, this is the transformation function that will be applied to source objects.
This executes JavaScript code with C3 type-system loaded and therefore does not have direct ability to use C3
expressions. If C3 expressions are necessary, the recommendation is to use {@link #projection}. Alternatively,
you can also use {@link Expr} to access C3 expressions.
